name: Vara
blurb: Drawing and digital painting application with pressure-sensitive brushes.
description:
Drawing and digital painting application with pressure-sensitive brushes.
It belongs to the group of applications like Krita and MyPaint, but
with a limited number of features. The main focus is on simplicity.

• Smooth and pressure-sensitive brushes

• Any number of layers

• 32-bit high dynamic range workflow

• Linear RGB colorspace with gamma correction

• Beginner-friendly, but advanced options available

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
